_readme: Capability registry for the canvas control plane. Each entry is ONE action the agent can run on a container via html_notes_app_action(app_id, action, params). Adding a repo or an action is a JSON edit here — no tool-schema rebuild and no lazy-agent redeploy, because the agent sees a single generic tool and this file is read at call time.

_field_docs.method/url: HTTP call to make. {placeholders} in url are filled from params.
_field_docs.body: JSON body template. A value of '$name' is replaced by params['name'] (dropped when absent); '$name!' is required. Any other value is sent literally.
_field_docs.destructive: true => the canvas renders a confirm card and NOTHING fires until the user clicks Run. Mark true for anything that spends money, deletes, or takes real-world action.
_field_docs.params: name -> one-line description. Purely documentation for the model; the executor does not type-check beyond required ($name!).
_field_docs.summary: Optional dotted path into the JSON response to quote back, e.g. 'data.status'.

start_cycle.description: Start a trading cycle (collect + analyze, and optionally place trades). Returns 409 if a cycle is already running — that is a normal answer, not an error.

params.tickers: Optional list of symbols, e.g. ['NVDA','AMD']. Omit to let the pipeline choose.
params.trade: true to actually place orders. Defaults to false (analysis only).
params.collect: Run data collection first. Default true.
params.max_tickers: Cap on how many symbols to process.

cycle_status.description: Current trading cycle state — whether one is running, which phase, and progress.

stop_cycle.description: Ask the running trading cycle to stop at the next safe point.

portfolio.description: the trading bot's PORTFOLIO headline numbers — value, P&L, win rate, open positions, cash. Use for "my portfolio", "how is the bot doing". query ignored Read-only; the same data canvas_add_widget(config={'toolsvc': 'portfolio'}) renders.

positions.description: the trading bot's OPEN POSITIONS as a table (ticker, qty, entry, price, P&L%, sector). Use for "my positions", "what am I holding". query ignored Read-only; the same data canvas_add_widget(config={'toolsvc': 'positions'}) renders.

watchlist.description: the trading bot's WATCHLIST. Use for "my watchlist". query ignored Read-only; the same data canvas_add_widget(config={'toolsvc': 'watchlist'}) renders.

market_regime.description: the MARKET REGIME read — risk-on/off label, breadth, dollar, VIX and yield signals. Use for "market regime", "risk on or off". query ignored Read-only; the same data canvas_add_widget(config={'toolsvc': 'market_regime'}) renders.

suggest_videos.description: Ask wallgarden's taste engine what to watch. Use this for VAGUE asks ('something to watch', 'find me something interesting') so the suggestion is informed by the user's own ratings and topics instead of a cold search. For a SPECIFIC ask ('bloomberg live news feed') just search normally.

params.query: REQUIRED. The subject or mood to find videos like.
params.interests: Optional list of extra interest strings to bias toward.
params.disliked: Optional list of strings to avoid.

taste_topics.description: Generate search topics from the user's taste. Use when you need good YouTube QUERIES rather than a specific video — it leverages the topics/ratings wallgarden already holds so you are not guessing from scratch.

params.interests: REQUIRED list of interest strings to brainstorm around.
params.numTopics: How many topics to return (default is wallgarden's own).

user_state.description: Read the user's wallgarden state — ratings, watched history, queue, mined topics and taste profile. Useful for grounding a recommendation in what they already liked.

record_play.description: Record that a track was played, so the music library's history and smart mixes learn from canvas listening too.

enrich_strains.description: Kick off strain-database enrichment. Heavy background job; self-guards with 409 when one is already running.

earthquakes.description: recent EARTHQUAKES on a map (USGS). Use for "earthquakes", "quakes", "seismic activity". query ignored Read-only; the same data canvas_add_widget(config={'toolsvc': 'earthquakes'}) renders.

wildfires.description: active WILDFIRES on a map (NASA EONET). query ignored Read-only; the same data canvas_add_widget(config={'toolsvc': 'wildfires'}) renders.

iss.description: where the International Space Station is RIGHT NOW + who is in space. query ignored Read-only; the same data canvas_add_widget(config={'toolsvc': 'iss'}) renders.

launches.description: upcoming / recent ROCKET LAUNCHES with photos (Launch Library). query ignored Read-only; the same data canvas_add_widget(config={'toolsvc': 'launches'}) renders.

apod.description: NASA's Astronomy Picture of the Day. query ignored Read-only; the same data canvas_add_widget(config={'toolsvc': 'apod'}) renders.

moon.description: the MOON tonight — phase, illumination, next new/full moon. query ignored Read-only; the same data canvas_add_widget(config={'toolsvc': 'moon'}) renders.

tides.description: today's TIDES (NOAA, San Francisco station). query ignored Read-only; the same data canvas_add_widget(config={'toolsvc': 'tides'}) renders.

space_weather.description: SPACE WEATHER — recent solar flares (NASA DONKI). Use for "solar flares", "geomagnetic storm", "aurora forecast". query ignored Read-only; the same data canvas_add_widget(config={'toolsvc': 'space_weather'}) renders.

commodities.description: COMMODITY / index / crypto MOVERS — biggest gainers and losers (oil, gold, indices). query ignored Read-only; the same data canvas_add_widget(config={'toolsvc': 'commodities'}) renders.

trends.description: WHAT'S TRENDING right now across Google, Wikipedia, HN, Mastodon, Bluesky, GitHub, TV. NOT for trending STOCKS (that is stock_trending). query ignored Read-only; the same data canvas_add_widget(config={'toolsvc': 'trends'}) renders.

spark.description: the DGX Spark GPU boxes right now — which model is up, tokens/s, queue, KV cache, TTFT. Use for "how are the sparks doing", "gpu status", "is vllm busy". query ignored Read-only; the same data canvas_add_widget(config={'toolsvc': 'spark'}) renders.

garden.description: the SmartGarden dashboard — active plants, pending tasks, tasks due soon, pests, recent harvests. Use for "my garden", "my plants". query ignored Read-only; the same data canvas_add_widget(config={'toolsvc': 'garden'}) renders.
